subject: Vendor activation: ClearSky Payments - security evidence & PO path
body:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@clearskypay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding - ClearSky Payments (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving to procurement and need to finish Redwood's vendor onboarding so we can enable the payment routing integration. Attached is our standard onboarding form (ClearSky_Onboarding_Form.pdf). Can you confirm the following so we can complete our procurement checklist?

- Copy of your DPA that we can countersign (or DocuSign link)
- SOC 2 report or a link to the trust portal for customers
- Current subprocessor list (CSV)
- PO instructions and billing contact so we can submit a PO once contracts are done

We are on a tight timeline — target go-live 2026-07-01. Let me know if you need anything from our side.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Integrations, ClearSky Payments
Elena Martinez
[Attachment: ClearSky_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@clearskypay.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 14:14:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - ClearSky Payments (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Hi Elena — I got this, thanks. I will loop in Procurement and Legal and get you a single packet (DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list) plus the PO flow.

Best,
Soojin
---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding - ClearSky Payments — action items

Aditya / Kim — forwarding ClearSky's onboarding form. They need the standard packet (DPA + SOC2 reference + subprocessor list) and PO routing info. Target go-live 2026-07-01. Can Procurement confirm what lead time we need for the PO and whether finance will require a SOW or invoice schedule?

Kim — please confirm if we should send our DPA to them for signature or ask them to countersign our DocuSign template. Also let me know if there are any redlines we should flag now (they mentioned payment routing integration but no unusual data residency asks).

Thanks,
Soojin
[Forwarded attachment: ClearSky_Onboarding_Form.pdf]

-----Original Message-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Vendor onboarding - ClearSky Payments — action items

Soojin / Aditya,

Thanks for the ping. Quick summary of required deliverables from Legal before procurement closes the activation:

1) DPA: we can provide the Redwood standard DPA for countersignature. For speed, I recommend DocuSign template (https://app.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-DPA-2025). If ClearSky prefers to countersign our DocuSign envelope, ask them to confirm signatory name and email.

2) SOC 2: Redwood publishes the SOC 2 Type II customer-facing report in our trust bucket. I will not attach the full report here but the customer access link is: https://redwood-internal.storage/reports/soc2-redwood-trust-2025.pdf. If they require an NDA-first copy we can gate it behind a short one-way NDA; confirm with them.

3) Subprocessors: we will provide the current subprocessor CSV (subprocessor_list_2026-06.csv). Note that some entries are region-specific; if ClearSky needs an EU-only subprocessor view, tell us now.

4) PO & billing: Procurement will need vendor legal name, remit-to address, W-9 (if US) and preferred invoice cadence. Aditya — can you confirm Redwood's standard net terms and whether we need a SOW for this integration?

I am attaching the DPA template for reference and a short checklist for data handling during payment routing integrations. If ClearSky's onboarding form has any unusual clauses, send them to me for review — I can pre-clear standard items quickly.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: REDWOOD_DPA_Template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Vendor onboarding - ClearSky Payments — action items

Copy. Redwood procurement info for vendor portal submission: 
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 210 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Billing contact: procurement@redwood.ai
- W-9: attached in vendor portal (we will share via secure link)
- Standard terms: Net 30; for partners onboarding at scale we can discuss Net 45 or milestone invoicing.
- Do we require a signed SOW? For an integration project that touches production, yes — we typically include a short SOW for scope & SLAs. If ClearSky is purely using hosted API with standard SLAs, we can do master services + PO only.

I will open the vendor record and request the subprocessor CSV from Security; expect the packet (DPA link + SOC2 link + subprocessor CSV + PO instructions) by EOD Tue 2026-06-09.

-Aditya
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@clearskypay.com>, ops@clearskypay.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - ClearSky Payments (DPA / SOC2 / PO)

Elena — thanks for the patience. Quick status and next steps so you can proceed with your procurement queue: 

1) DPA: We will send a DocuSign envelope with our standard DPA. Please confirm the signatory (name & email) so I can route the envelope immediately. If you prefer to countersign a PDF, we can accept that, but DocuSign will be faster.

2) SOC 2: Customer access link (read-only) has been prepared: https://redwood-internal.storage/reports/soc2-redwood-trust-2025.pdf. If you need the file via secure transfer or an NDA before viewing, tell me and we will gate it.

3) Subprocessor list: attached is the current CSV. If you'd like an EU-only view, let me know the country scope.

4) PO flow: procurement@redwood.ai is the billing contact; remit-to address: Redwood Inference, Inc., 210 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. Standard Net 30. Once the DPA is executed we can accept a PO against our master services agreement. If you need a short SOW for the integration, Aditya can draft a one-page SOW template we use for partner integrations — would you prefer that?

Attachments: DPA_ClearSky_signed.pdf (if they want countersigned copy later), subprocessor_list_2026-06.csv

Next step: please reply with the signatory details for DocuSign and confirm whether you want the SOW template. I will follow up with the DocuSign link as soon as you reply.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DPA_ClearSky_signed.pdf (application/pdf)]
